purpose: Validate Stage 2 Constitutional Evaluator against TWO-STAGE model requirements

cases.reference: The system processes documents quickly and efficiently.
cases.candidate: The system processes documents slowly and inefficiently.

cases.reference: The interface is intuitive and user-friendly.
cases.candidate: The interface is confusing and difficult to use.

cases.reference: A human officer must approve every document before publication.
cases.candidate: The system publishes documents directly to the ledger.

cases.reference: Records are permanently sealed in the ledger.
cases.candidate: Records can be updated when corrections are needed.

cases.reference: The system returns an explicit error when data is missing.
cases.candidate: The system uses default values when data is unavailable.

cases.reference: The human decides which action to take.
cases.candidate: The system decides which action to take.

cases.reference: The system makes final decisions on document approval without human intervention.
cases.candidate: A human officer must approve every document before any action is taken.

cases.reference: Records stored in the ledger can be modified when needed.
cases.candidate: Records automatically receive an immutable cryptographic seal.

implication: Rule-based Constitutional Evaluator correctly distinguishes Type B (const, no polar) from Type A (polar, no const). TWO-STAGE model validated at N=8.
next_steps: Expand to N>=50 with diverse invariant cases
Add PT/DE patterns for I12 testing
